# Pricing of Tallybook, Billfold and Sumwise (October 2026)

| Product | Entry plan | Mid plan | Top plan | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tallybook | $15/month | $45/month | $110/month | Multi-currency only on the top plan |
| Billfold | $9/month | $29/month | n/a | Freelancer-focused, 2 plans |
| Sumwise | $25/month | $60/month | $140/month | Includes payroll for up to 5 employees |

## Positioning
Ledgerly's Team plan ($39) sits between Billfold and Tallybook mid plans. Sumwise is the most expensive but bundles payroll.
